headline: War-led cost strain; LT growth hinges on execution

highlights: Higher metal volumes and better alumina realisations aided profitability.
Metal volumes grew 8% YoY to 121kt, while alumina volumes declined 14% YoY to 340kt amid temporary export dispatch disruptions.
EBITDA grew 25% YoY to INR24.1bn, while a sharp increase in raw material and power and fuel costs of 43% and 45% YoY, respectively, limiting sequential margin improvement.
In medium term, NACL's earnings will remain largely driven by alumina/ aluminum pricing, with the next leg of volume growth dependent on its execution.
